overall_summary: Initial deep focus on niche romantic heartbreak and self-respect smartphone/digital micro-habits generated moderate views (up to 41). However, expansion into broader, universal family and relationship emotional bonds (e.g., parents, spouse, calling a loved one) massively outperformed the channel baseline, peaking at 1451 views.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about spouses, parents, and making a call to a loved one (e.g., 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1451 views, 'आज किसी अपने को Call कर लेना' with 288 views) vastly outperformed niche heartbreak skits.
winning_patterns.action: Pivot the core narrative focus from isolated breakup pain toward broader, highly relatable familial and emotional relationship bonds.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos tackling grounded human truths like 'तुम थके हो… हारे नहीं' received 171 views and solid engagement compared to toxic or hyper-specific phone-checking habits.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate supportive, reassuring philosophical life lessons into the emotional arcs.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos hyper-focused on specific digital deletions (widget removals, blocking, removing special ringtones) posted recently had very low views (0 to 10 views), indicating fatigue or over-saturation in this specific sub-format.
weak_patterns.action: Reduce reliance on ultra-specific digital breakup tropes and focus on broader emotional dynamics.
